description.zh:
付费类型，支持预付费和后付费，可选值：
- PrePaid 预付费
- PostPaid 后付费
description.en:
The billing method. Valid values:
- PrePaid: subscription.
- PostPaid: pay-as-you-go.

description.zh: 查询资源时的筛选条件列表。
description.en: The filter conditions for querying resources.

description.zh:
查询实例时的筛选键。取值范围：

- 当该参数取值为ExpiredStartTime时，可以查询指定过期时间点（Filter.N.Value）后创建的资源信息。

- 当该参数取值为ExpiredEndTime时，可以查询在指定过期时间点（Filter.N.Value）前创建的资源信息。

- 当该参数取值为CreationStartTime时，可以查询在指定创建时间点（Filter.N.Value）后创建的资源信息。

- 当该参数取值为CreationEndTime时，可以查询在指定过期时间点（Filter.N.Value）前创建的资源信息。
description.en:
The filter key for querying instances. Valid values:

- ExpiredStartTime: queries resources that expire after the time specified by Filter.N.Value.

- ExpiredEndTime: queries resources that expire before the time specified by Filter.N.Value.

- CreationStartTime: queries resources created after the time specified by Filter.N.Value.

- CreationEndTime: queries resources created before the time specified by Filter.N.Value.

description.zh: 查询实例时的筛选值。指定该参数时必须同时指定Filter.N.Key参数，格式为:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ，采用UTC+0时区。
description.en: The filter value for querying instances. When you specify this parameter, you must also specify Filter.N.Key. The value is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format in UTC+0.

description.zh: 云手机实例ID，N的取值范围：1~100。
description.en: The instance IDs of the cloud phone instances. Valid values of N: 1 to 100.
The name of the cloud phone instance.

description.zh: 密钥对名称。必须保持名称唯一性。 长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以 http:// 和 https:// 开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）。
description.en: The name of the key pair. The name must be unique. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter. The name cannot start with http:// or https://.

description.zh: 返回的最大数，取值范围：1~100。
description.en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 100.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值，初次调用无需配置。
description.en: The query token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first call.

description.zh: 云手机实例所在的地域。
description.en: The region where the cloud phone instances reside.
The resolution used by the cloud phone.
Specifies whether to return webRtcToken in the query results.

description.zh:
实例状态。取值范围：
- Pending：创建中
- Running：运行中
- Starting：启动中
- Stopping：停止中
- Stopped：已停止
- Expired: 已过期
description.en:
The instance status. Valid values:
- Pending: being created.
- Running: running.
- Starting: being started.
- Stopping: being stopped.
- Stopped: stopped.
- Expired: expired.

description.zh: 根据指定的标签筛选实例。
description.en: The tags used to filter instances.

description.zh: 实例的标签键。N的取值范围为1~20。
description.en: The tag key of the instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

description.zh: 实例的标签值。N的取值范围为1~20。
description.en: The tag value of the instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.
The zone where the cloud phone resides.

descriptions.zh:
- 此接口只支持NextToken查询方式
- 返回结果按照云手机创建时间顺序正序返回
- 通过NextToken设置查询凭证（Token），其取值是上一次调用ListInstances返回的NextToken参数值，再通过MaxResults设置单页查询的最大条目数。
descriptions.en:
- This operation supports only NextToken-based queries.
- Results are returned in ascending order of cloud phone creation time.
- Set the query token by specifying NextToken, whose value is the NextToken parameter value returned by the previous call to ListInstances. Set MaxResults to specify the maximum number of entries per page.
